product_one_liner.value: Sona is an AI-powered workforce management platform for large frontline organisations, combining demand forecasting, scheduling, time and attendance, HR, payroll and employee communications.

pricing_page.notes: The URL titled Pricing offers a consultation and custom-quote request, not published prices or plan tiers; treated as a contact-only pricing page under the requested definition.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 253 employees; this numeric headcount determines the band rather than its broader company-size label.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is primarily workforce-management, product and industry content; no two qualifying engineering-authored product-build posts were established.

public_docs.notes: The public help centre contains multiple articles on using the app, clocking in and out, payslips and technical issues.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current board lists Labour AI Specialist, a role involving labour modelling, forecasting and scheduling tooling, rather than AI sales.

model_provider.notes: The official Trust Center lists Anthropic as a Large Language Model subprocessor; it does not identify a specific model version.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center explicitly states ISO 27001:2022 certification. GDPR contractual commitments are not treated as a separate certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The April 1, 2026 Series B falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live board lists Business Development Representative and several Account Executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: The June 22, 2026 announcement introduces Sona LMS, a native learning-management product, within the May 9–November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jennifer Johnson announced joining as VP, Solution Marketing on September 22, 2026; the CEO confirmed her appointment on September 29, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A May 28, 2026 hiring announcement names HubSpot, Gong, Lemlist and Sales Nav. An older Revenue Operations Manager posting also names ZoomInfo and Trumpet; those two are historical signals, not confirmed current deployments.
